items.title: Queimadas (BA) IT procurement · direct award (dispensa) · closes Nov 29 #030
items.en_title: Queimadas (BA) IT procurement · direct award (dispensa) · closes Nov 29 #030
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Queimadas (BA) is procuring IT equipment, systems or services through direct award (dispensa), with an estimated value of about R$ 2,839.20; proposals close Nov 29, 17:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
